question: Where is the Royal Ascot Racecourse situated?
solution:
The correct answer is **England.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Ascot Racecourse**

 
 
• The t**horoughbred horse racing** takes place at Ascot Racecourse, a British racetrack in **Ascot, Berkshire, England.**
 
• In the middle of **June,** Royal Ascot is an annual Flat racing meeting that lasts** five days** and features **18 Group races**, which are the best Flat races.
 
• About **600,000 people **annually visit Ascot Racecourse, which hosts **10% of all UK racegoers.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Family racedays at Ascot**

 
 
• The **Spring Family** Raceday in March.
 
• The **Summer Mile Family** Raceday in July.
 
• The **Fireworks Spectacular Family** Raceday in October or November.
 
• The **Christmas Family** Raceday in December.
 
 
 
• **Royal Ascot Cricket Club**
 
 
• The **Royal Ascot Cricket Club**, which was established in** 1883**, is also based at the racetrack.
 
• The stadium for the club is in the **middle of the racecourse.**
